verses.en: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.sm: Atua e, ia e faafofoga mai i laʻu tatalo; ia e leoleo mai i loʻu ola ia le mataʻu i le ua ita mai.

verses.en: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
verses.sm: la e natia aʻu ai le taupulepulega a e amio leaga, ma le faanunununu o e fai amioletonu.

verses.en: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
verses.sm: Ua latou faamataina o latou laulaufaiva e pei o se pelu; ua latou lolou i aufana e fana mai a latou u,

verses.en: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
verses.sm: o upu ogo lava ia; ina ia latou fana lafitai i le ua amio sao; e faafuasei ona latou fana ia te ia, latou te le matatau lava.

verses.en: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?
verses.sm: Ua latou fefaamalosiai i le mea leaga; ua latou filifili e natia ni matásele; ua latou faapea ane, O ai se na te ¡loa i latou?

verses.en: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
verses.sm: Ua latou saili mea leaga; ua faapea ane, Ua uma ona tatou matuā sailiili lava; o latou mafaufau taitasi ma le loto ua suegata lava.

verses.en: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
verses.sm: A o le Atua, na te fanaina atu le u ia te i latou e faafuasei; e manunua ai i latou.

verses.en: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
verses.sm: E leaga ; latou i o latou lava laulaufaiva; e taitasi ma sola ese lava o e vaavaai ia te i latou.

verses.en: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
verses.sm: E matatau tagata uma, latou “e faaaliina atu foi le mea ua faia e le Atua; latou :e mafaufau foi i lana galuega.

verses.en: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
verses.sm: E fiafia lē amiotonu i le ALII, ma faalagolago ia te ia; ona mitamita ai lea o i latou uma ua loto saʻo. Io SALAMO
